search_jina_web_query: search using Jina Search API with a query string and return list of SearchResult objects
search_jina_with_api_key: search Jina API using an authentication key and return up to 10 search results
search_jina_custom_base_url: search Jina API with a custom base URL instead of the default endpoint
search_jina_limit_results: search Jina API and limit returned results to a maximum of 10 entries
search_jina_parse_responses: search Jina API and parse JSON response into SearchResult objects with link, title, and snippet
